# r/OrlandoMagic (post by hand; read the sub's self-promotion rules first)

**Title:** Where the Orlando Magic stand in The 644, our ranking of all 644 NBA players

**Body:**

The Orlando Magic in The 644, our ranking of every NBA player. The top eight by rank, with each player's GRAVITY score (50 is a league-average minute):

- #29 Franz Wagner 60.3
- #33 Paolo Banchero 60.0
- #36 Desmond Bane 59.7
- #92 Goga Bitadze 53.3
- #101 Jalen Suggs 52.2
- #116 Wendell Carter Jr. 51.0
- #130 Nikola Vučević 48.7
- #152 Anthony Black 47.4

GRAVITY is our one-number player rating: how good, times how often. Every player has a free profile page, and the table filters by team: https://thegravityreport.com/the644/

Happy to answer questions about the method in the comments.
